body: road dust coats the lug wrench and hand torch, but their ties are clean and newly cut. the bundle was repacked after travel.
title: Lug wrench with the unclosed tally
gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

body:
Keep the pesticide trial jars sealed until the boundary check is done. The neighbor keeps knocking because the map says don't go; the dog is still in the yard.

We kept one copy for ourselves. The person collecting the other one said the numbers would be corrected later, once everyone had moved.

I do not know which of the two accounts was repeated afterward. The older one is the one I had in my hands that day.
title: The jars stay sealed
gloss: A field-trial warning and a household access problem remain on the same note.
rival_reading: A response crew could have sealed ordinary pest-control supplies while closing an area; keeping the jars shut does not show the trial malfunctioned.
